notes.title: Game Update - 2025/4/27
notes.notes:
[h3]Update[/h3]
[list]
[*]Adjust the characteristics of the characters, and the casting interface increased on the description of the character
[*]When grasping an item, if the item affects the attribute, a prompt arrow will be displayed next to the corresponding attribute/secondary attribute
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed the issue where the game Settings were not correctly saved to the save file
[*]Fixed the issue where the movement speed of the character did not change according to the actual movement speed
[*]Fix the issue where the bullets fired by the character in the tutorial would be misaligned
[/list]

notes.title: Game Update - 2025/4/20
notes.notes:
[h3]Update[/h3]
[list]
[*]New tutorials have been added to the game on combat, shop, crafting, and selecting the initial ultimate, as well as a small level
[*]After upgrading the department and placing items that directly increase/decrease attributes, the secondary attribute panel of the store now changes the number color of the corresponding attribute according to the increase or decrease of the attribute
[*]Optimize the name prompt during item synthesis and the display of the item synthesis prompt line
[*]Optimize the size of the character and ultimate skill description information on the casting page to reserve more space for explanation
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed the issue where the prompt text next to the mouse did not appear when using the ultimate move
[*]Fixed the issue where an error would be directly reported and the game would freeze if both sides in the "Battle Mode" held the throwing tile badge
[*]Fixed the issue where the terrain in the first level would jam the character's position
[*]Fixed the issue where the attributes of opponents in "Versus Mode" would occasionally double
[*]Fixed the issue where the "Lucky Refresh" probability introduction box in the first level of the "Versus Mode" was not displayed correctly
[/list]

notes.title: Game Update - 2025/4/11
notes.notes:
[h3]Update[/h3]
[list]
[*]Adjusted the display logic of the item information box in the store interface, now the items in the backpack will be fixed to the right when the information box is displayed
[*]For items that meet the composition criteria, when viewing the item information box, the information box for items that can be composed is also displayed
[*]Adjusted the game's base volume Settings, now background music is not as loud by default
[/list]
[*]Adjusted the movement speed of some monsters and the effects of some components
[h3]Bug Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a Bug where the item info box would not appear when putting down an item
[*]Fixed an issue where the item information box in the map was displayed differently at different resolutions
[*]Fixed some problems where parabolic trajectory judgment was skewed
[*]Fixed an issue where items were not composited when "Versus Mode" failed
[/list]

notes.title: Game Update - 2025/4/3
notes.notes:
[h3]Update[/h3]
[list]
[*] Some players feedback that the difference between the two refresh methods of the store is not large, and we find that the difference between the two refresh methods is not intuitive. We adjust it to show the probability of refreshing items after the mouse moves on it, so that the refresh probability can be compared more intuitively
[*] In recent days, many players have reported that the current difficulty is unreasonable, the previous level is very difficult, we are also trying to adjust these days, this update we readjusting the distribution of the first two levels of items, and also readjusting the unreasonable place in the damage calculation, we will follow up the experience problems, and thank you very much for your feedback
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the gun emplacements would sometimes only act and not fire missiles
[/list]

notes.title: Game Update - 2025/4/2
notes.notes:
[h3]Bug Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some players could not enter the game because the path contained special characters
[*] Fixed an issue where the billing interface volume was too high
[*] Fixed incorrect hover window position and content
[/list]

notes.title: Game Update - 2025/4/1
notes.notes:
[h3]Bug Fixed[/h3]

[*] Fixed the "Versus Mode" server
